title: Shipping Name Autofill Fix

sections.name: Checkout
items: First Name and Last Name are now matched to their visible checkout labels.
Each profile field is assigned to a unique input so one name cannot overwrite the other.
The complete guest checkout flow continues through shipping, payment, review, and Place Order.

sections.name: CAPTCHA
items: Checkout pauses only when a CAPTCHA is actually present and resumes from the interrupted step.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
